tasks.title: Final invoice in EUR with distractors
tasks.prompt:
Extract the FINAL invoice record and return ONLY a JSON object (no other text).

From: accounts@kestrel-labs.example
Subject: Invoice question - please ignore earlier draft
Hi team,
This note supersedes the draft invoice INV-2026-1799 sent on 01/03/2026.
The draft total was EUR 1,900.00 and should NOT be used.
FINAL INVOICE RECORD (use this one):
Vendor: Kestrel Labs GmbH
Invoice ID: INV-2026-1842
Issued: 15/03/2026
Due: April 14, 2026
Contact: billing@kestrel-labs.example
Status: overdue - yes, it is overdue
Items billed, priced in EUR per unit:
  - SKU KL-100, qty 4, EUR 600.00 each
  - SKU KL-200, qty 2, EUR 300.00 each
Subtotal: EUR 3,000.00
Tax: EUR 570.00
Total charged: EUR 3,570.00
Note: our old portal quote of EUR 2,856.00 was for a smaller order.
Please pay the final total above, converted as instructed.
Thanks, Priya

Rules:
- Use only the FINAL INVOICE RECORD; ignore the earlier draft INV-2026-1799 and the old portal quote.
- Dates must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Issued is in DD/MM/YYYY format; Due is written as 'Month D, YYYY'.
- Money: all amounts in the record are in EUR. Convert EUR to USD at 1 EUR = 1.08 USD. Report total_usd and each item unit_price_usd rounded to 2 decimal places.
- Fields (exact names): vendor (string), invoice_id (string), issued_on (string), due_on (string), contact_email (string), overdue (boolean, true if the record says overdue), total_usd (number), items (array of objects in the order listed, each with sku (string), qty (integer), unit_price_usd (number)).

tasks.title: Sensor reading with Celsius conversion
tasks.prompt:
Extract the active-unit reading and return ONLY a JSON object (no other text).

LAB LOG EXPORT - device registry
Registry entry (old): DEV-OLD-7, retired 2025-11-30
Ignore retired units above; only the active unit below counts.
Active unit: DEV-2841 (ward B)
Reading taken: 02 Mar 2026
Ambient: 21.4 C, humidity 38 percent
Sample 1: 35.0 C at 08:00
Sample 2: 36.5 C at 09:30  <-- use this reading
Sample 3: 37.2 C at 11:00 (after lunch, discard)
Operator: M. Okafor
Threshold (Fahrenheit): 98.6 F
Status at Sample 2: within threshold
Calibration due: 2026-09-01
Firmware: 4.2.1
Battery: 87 percent
Note: an earlier manual entry recorded 36.5 C as 96.5 F.
That manual conversion was wrong; convert it yourself.
End of export for DEV-2841.

Rules:
- Use only the active unit DEV-2841 and Sample 2; ignore the retired unit, Sample 1, Sample 3, and the manual conversion note.
- Date must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD (the reading date is written as 'DD Mon YYYY').
- Convert Sample 2 from Celsius to Fahrenheit using F = C x 9/5 + 32. Report reading_f rounded to 1 decimal place.
- Fields (exact names): device_id (string), measured_on (string), reading_f (number), threshold_f (number), operator (string), status (string, exactly as stated for Sample 2), calibration_due (string, ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

tasks.title: Revised booking in GBP with pounds conversion
tasks.prompt:
Extract the revised booking and return ONLY a JSON object (no other text).

=== BOOKING CONFIRMATION (revised) ===
This replaces confirmation ZQ-9911 from January.
Do not use ZQ-9911; it was cancelled.
Traveller: Jonas Weber
Confirmation: ZQ-7742
Depart: 03/04/2026 (outbound)
Return: 17 April 2026
Route: Berlin to Lisbon
Fare quoted: GBP 640.00
Airport taxes: GBP 85.00
Total charged: GBP 725.00
Passengers:
  1. Jonas Weber, seat 14A
  2. Ana Sousa, seat 14B
Checked luggage allowance: 22 lb
Gate closes 20 minutes before departure
Original booking had seat 9C for Jonas; revised is 14A.
Meal preference: vegetarian (for Ana)
Booking agent: T. Haddad

Rules:

tasks.title: Expense claim in European number format
tasks.prompt:
Extract the final claim and return ONLY a JSON object (no other text).

EXPENSE CLAIM - Northwind University
Claim ID (old draft): EXP-2025-310
Draft from November 2025 is void; use the final claim below.
FINAL CLAIM:
Applicant: Priya Raman
Project code: NW-2026-041
Submitted: March 5, 2026
Department: Chemistry
Approved: yes
Receipts (amounts in EUR as printed):
  - R-101, EUR 1.234,56, category: equipment
  - R-102, EUR 250,00, category: travel
  - R-103, EUR 99,99, category: supplies [REJECTED - no receipt]
Total of accepted receipts: EUR 1.484,56
An old claim listed EUR 1.100,00 for R-101; that was a typo.
Currency note: European format, dot = thousands, comma = decimal point.
Reimbursement limit: EUR 2.000,00
Signed: P. Raman
Finance ref: FIN-8841
End of claim form.

Rules:
- Use only the FINAL CLAIM; ignore the void draft EXP-2025-310 and the old typo amount.
- Include ONLY accepted receipts (exclude the rejected R-103), in the order listed.
- Date must be ISO YYYY-MM-DD (submitted is written as 'Month D, YYYY').
- European number format: dot is the thousands separator and comma is the decimal point (e.g. EUR 1.234,56 = 1234.56 EUR).
- Money: convert EUR to USD at 1 EUR = 1.10 USD. Report total_usd and each receipt amount_usd rounded to 2 decimal places. The total is the sum of the accepted receipts.
- Fields (exact names): applicant (string), project_code (string), submitted_on (string), department (string), approved (boolean), total_usd (number), receipts (array of objects in the order listed, each with id (string), amount_usd (number), category (string)).
